description: This Java test class 'HibernateAlertDAOTest' verifies the behavior of the Hibernate-based data access object for 'Alert' entities in the OpenMRS project. It includes setup procedures, CRUD operation tests, and filtering logic, specifically for alert expiration and retrieval.

classes.name: HibernateAlertDAOTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing Hibernate DAO operations related to Alert entity in OpenMRS.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data before each test, including setting an alert's expiration date.

methods.name: saveAlert_shouldSaveAlertToDb
methods.description: Tests that a new Alert can be saved and retrieved from the database.

methods.name: getAlert_shouldGetAlertById
methods.description: Verifies that an Alert can be retrieved correctly by its ID.

methods.name: deleteAlert_shouldReturnNullAfterDeleting
methods.description: Checks that deleting an Alert results in it no longer being retrievable.

methods.name: getAllAlerts_shouldReturnOnlyNonExpiredAllerts
methods.description: Ensures that only non-expired Alerts are returned when filtering is applied.

methods.name: getAlerts_shouldReturnAllAlertsWhenUserIsSpecified
methods.description: Validates retrieving Alerts for a specific user, confirming filtering by user context.
